summary_1line: After years in Kuvera’s domain, the Pandavas decide to leave, journey across Kailasa and sacred regions, and continue their exile toward the lands of Suvahu.

image_candidates.scene_text: Yudhishthira stands before the towering mountain, hands raised in prayer, asking to return after reclaiming his kingdom.
Ghatotkacha and his followers carry the Pandavas across roaring mountain cascades beneath the snowy heights.
The Pandavas travel armed with bows along the craggy passes of Kailasa, surrounded by waterfalls, lion dens, and vast forests.
